symbol_validation.note: PDB stream age is 3; DBI age is 1 and matches the PE CodeView age. GUID and all 22 section layouts match the installed DLL.

limitations: No target or runtime binder execution; this maps shipped custom descriptors and SharedLibrary table bytes.
A resolved address alone does not establish its source method name; symbol or instruction corroboration is needed.

Per-address symbol records are capped at 64 with explicit total/truncation flags. Complete aliases remain in sharedlibrary-symbols.json; compiler folding can create thousands of aliases at a single ret instruction.
